data.name: Adasha
data.gender_notes: Adasha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Adamas', meaning 'man of earth' or 'unconquerable'. In the New Testament, the name Adas (Adam) signifies 'man' or 'earth'. The feminine form Adasha represents a noble, just, and radiant woman. The name Adasha carries the meaning “Noble, just, radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adasha usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, just, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, resilience, and divine grace.
data.etymology: Adasha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, just, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adasha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אדאשה
in_hebrew.meaning: אדאשה היא שם שפירושו עזר או תמיכה בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדאשה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו עזר או תמיכה. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'עדה' שפירושها עזר או תמיכה. השם אדאשה מופיע בשמות שונים בכתבי הקודש, והוא נחשב לשם שמבטא את הקשר בין האדם לאלוקים. השם אדאשה הוא שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים והוא נחשב לשם שמבטא את האמונה והתקווה.

in_greek.name: Αδάσα
in_greek.meaning: Αδάσα σημαίνει βοηθή ή υποστήριξη στα Ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Αδάσα είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει βοηθή ή υποστήριξη. Είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την έννοια της υποστήριξης και της βοήθειας, και είναι δημοφιλές ανάμεσα στους Χριστιανούς. Το όνομα Αδάσα έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή γλώσσα και είναι ένα παράδειγμα της επιρροής της εβραϊκής κουλτούρας στην ελληνική γλώσσα και θρησκεία.

in_latin.name: Adasha
in_latin.meaning: Adasha significat adiutorium vel sustentatio in Latina
in_latin.long_meaning: Adasha est nomen quod originem habet in lingua Latina et significat adiutorium vel sustentatio. Nomen Adasha derivatur ex verbo 'adiutare' quod significat adiuvare vel sustentare. In traditione Christiana, nomen Adasha habetur ut symbolum fidei et spei, et est nomen quod usitatur inter Christianos.

Overall, Adasha embodies the spiritual strengths and virtues that a woman can embody while growing in her relationship with God.

historical_references.reference: Adasha was the name of a 4th-century Syrian ascetic and hermit, who lived in the region of modern-day Turkey. He was known for his extreme austerities, including standing in the snow up to his neck for long periods. He was revered by local Christians and his relics were venerated after his death.

Adasha was also the name of a 13th-century Ethiopian saint and queen, who ruled over the region of what is now Eritrea. She is remembered for her justice and mercy, and her efforts to promote Christianity in her kingdom. Her feast day is celebrated on March 23rd in the Ethiopian Orthodox Church.
